entries.reviewFinding: Important CP16 evidence underclassification: printed prose explicitly establishes two heavy proton torpedo tubes despite the corresponding source ledger row having SOURCE_SILENT_CONFIRMED hardwareCount. Promote only via audited correction, and do not infer arc, magazine-to-launcher equivalence, or physical counts for turbolaser batteries.
